title: Coefficients of a linear image are fixed finite linear combinations
statement: Let n be a natural number, V = HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n, A : V →ₗ[ℂ] V, and e : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ. For r ∈ Fin(n+1), put d_r = Finsupp.single 0 r.val + Finsupp.single 1 (n−r.val). There exists c : Fin(n+1) → ℂ, independent of Q, such that every Q ∈ V satisfies coeff e((A Q).val) = Σ_{r∈Fin(n+1)} c(r)·coeff d_r(Q.val).
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (A : ↥(HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n) →ₗ[ℂ] ↥(HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n)) (e : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ), ∃ c : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ, ∀ Q : ↥(HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n), MvPolynomial.coeff e (A Q).val = ∑ r : Fin (n + 1), c r * MvPolynomial.coeff (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) r.val + Finsupp.single (1 : Fin 2) (n - r.val)) Q.val
